title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Given the heads of two sorted linked lists list1 and list2, merge the two lists into one sorted list and return its head.

hints.content: Use a dummy head node and a tail pointer.
Repeatedly attach the smaller of the two current nodes.

solution.code: function solve(input) { const { list1, list2 } = input; const out = []; let i = 0, j = 0; while (i < list1.length && j < list2.length) { out.push(list1[i] <= list2[j] ? list1[i++] : list2[j++]); } return out.concat(list1.slice(i), list2.slice(j)); }
solution.explanation: Walk both sorted arrays with two pointers, always taking the smaller head; then append whatever is left of the other array. O(n + m) time.
